# Vitul Release Notes

The Vitul source of truth is the [GitLab project](https://gitlab.litevar.com:90/litevar/agentos/vitul).
The GitHub Actions and Covector release files in this repository were inherited
from the compatibility codebase. They still refer to its package and publishing
identities and are not the Vitul release pipeline.

Do not use those inherited workflows to publish Vitul packages. A Vitul release
process must be configured for the GitLab project before publishing artifacts.
